Each cell is a Hamiltonian kicked rotor: the compiled step advances both its angle and conjugate momentum while coupling it to the surrounding lattice. The update is derived in SymPy, lowered to AbstractTensor Python, and compiled to WGSL by the repository's own WebGPU backend — at Precision[2, float32], two 24-bit limbs, because WGSL has no f64 and two limbs carry more significand than the f64 they replace. The split two_product means no fused multiply-add appears, so WGSL's permission to double-round fma() never applies.
